title: Everything you think you know about addiction is wrong | Johann Hari | TED
summary: Johann Hari's TED talk arguing that addiction is driven largely by disconnection and environment rather than chemical hooks alone. He draws on his personal experience with addicted relatives and on research and policy examples from around the world.
why: HN commenters quote it for the line that the opposite of addiction is connection, and recommend it as a more plausible account of addiction than the standard model.

quote.text: This is my favourite addiction talk.
